title: Reserve stock at checkout
description: Checkout now reserves stock before payment so we stop overselling flash-sale items. Wrapped in a transaction so the reservation and the stock decrement commit together.

expected_issues.description: Check-then-act without a row lock: `transaction.atomic` does not lock the row, so two concurrent checkouts can both read the same `available`, both pass the check, and the second save overwrites the first (overselling). Use `select_for_update()` as `release_reservation` does, or a conditional `F()` update.
